_docs: Remote assertions read by the maintainer's private two-repo sync tool, which is not part of this build; the file is harmless to leave as placeholders. All three keys are REQUIRED and public_forbidden must be non-empty or the tool refuses to push (exit 3). claude_remote / user_remote are substring-matched against `git remote get-url origin` of ~/.claude and ~/.config/LIFEOS/USER, so `owner/repo` works for both ssh and https remotes. public_forbidden[0] is the public LifeOS repo slug: if either remote contains it the push is refused. Replace claude_remote and user_remote with your own PRIVATE repos; replace public_forbidden[0] with the public repo slug you must never push to.
